usedFor: Baserow rows start the work, and Google Drive handles files through “Copy a File” and “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “Row Updated” in Baserow, then “Share File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Access follows the data: when a row changes, a chosen user gets Viewer, Commenter or Editor rights on the file.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” makes a link open to anyone, so check the access level before you turn it on.
